/**
 * @name Code injection via eval/exec/compile
 * @description Using eval, exec, or compile with potentially untrusted input can lead to arbitrary code execution
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity error
 * @id py/code-injection-eval-exec
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-094
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  (
    call = API::builtin(["eval", "exec", "compile"]).getACall() or
    call = API::moduleImport("builtins").getMember(["eval", "exec", "compile"]).getACall()
  )
select call, "Potentially unsafe use of " + call.getFunction().asExpr().(Name).getId() + " that could execute arbitrary code."
findings.hypothesis: Check for dangerous code execution functions like eval, exec, or compile that could allow arbitrary code execution

findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Path traversal in file operations
 * @description File operations with unsanitized user input can lead to path traversal
 * @kind path-problem
 * @problem.severity error
 * @id py/path-traversal
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-022
 */

import python
import semmle.python.dataflow.new.DataFlow
import semmle.python.dataflow.new.TaintTracking
import semmle.python.dataflow.new.RemoteFlowSources
import semmle.python.Concepts

module PathTraversalConfig implements DataFlow::ConfigSig {
  predicate isSource(DataFlow::Node source) {
    source instanceof RemoteFlowSource
  }

  predicate isSink(DataFlow::Node sink) {
    sink = any(FileSystemAccess fa).getAPathArgument()
  }
}

module PathTraversalFlow = TaintTracking::Global<PathTraversalConfig>;
import PathTraversalFlow::PathGraph

from PathTraversalFlow::PathNode source, PathTraversalFlow::PathNode sink
where PathTraversalFlow::flowPath(source, sink)
select sink.getNode(), source, sink, "Path traversal from $@.", source.getNode(), "user input"
findings.hypothesis: Path traversal vulnerabilities in file operations

findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Regular expression denial of service
 * @description Inefficient regular expressions can cause denial of service
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity warning
 * @id py/redos
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-1333
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call, string pattern
where
  (
    call = API::moduleImport("re").getMember(["compile", "match", "search", "findall", "finditer", "sub", "subn", "split"]).getACall() or
    call = API::builtin("compile").getACall()
  ) and
  exists(DataFlow::Node arg |
    arg = call.getArg(0) and
    arg.asExpr().(StrConst).getText() = pattern and
    (
      pattern.regexpMatch(".*\\(.*\\+.*\\)\\+.*") or
      pattern.regexpMatch(".*\\(.*\\*.*\\)\\+.*") or
      pattern.regexpMatch(".*\\(.*\\+.*\\)\\*.*") or
      pattern.regexpMatch(".*\\(.*\\{.*,.*\\}.*\\)\\+.*")
    )
  )
select call, "Regular expression with potential exponential backtracking: " + pattern
findings.hypothesis: Regular expression denial of service (ReDoS) vulnerabilities

findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name ReDoS via user-controlled regex pattern
 * @description Using user-controlled input as a regex pattern can lead to ReDoS attacks
 * @kind path-problem
 * @problem.severity high
 * @id py/redos-user-pattern
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-1333
 */

import python
import semmle.python.dataflow.new.DataFlow
import semmle.python.dataflow.new.TaintTracking
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

module ReDoSConfig implements DataFlow::ConfigSig {
  predicate isSource(DataFlow::Node source) {
    exists(DataFlow::CallCfgNode call |
      call = API::moduleImport("json").getMember("loads").getACall() or
      call = API::moduleImport("json").getMember("load").getACall()
      |
      source = call
    )
  }

  predicate isSink(DataFlow::Node sink) {
    exists(DataFlow::CallCfgNode call |
      call = API::moduleImport("re").getMember(["search", "match", "compile", "findall", "finditer"]).getACall() and
      sink = call.getArg(0)
    )
  }
}

module ReDoSFlow = TaintTracking::Global<ReDoSConfig>;
import ReDoSFlow::PathGraph

from ReDoSFlow::PathNode source, ReDoSFlow::PathNode sink
where ReDoSFlow::flowPath(source, sink)
select sink.getNode(), source, sink, "ReDoS vulnerability: regex pattern from $@.", source.getNode(), "user input"
findings.hypothesis: ReDoS vulnerability where user-controlled JSON input flows into regex pattern parameter
